ruled_out_as_direct_explanation_for_thes: Malformed JSON in the actual 500 SFT targets: all parse as JSON. This does not certify their semantic labels.
A malformed JSON example in the audit prompt: the supplied example parses and has the specified keys.
Prompt truncation or output-token cap: captured inputs are below 2048, outputs below 1024, with no recorded truncation or cap hits.
A total inability to emit the original operations format: the same run accepts all 12 normal proposals, although their semantics may be wrong.
Audit runtime silently discarding legal committed repairs: all failures occur at parsing/field validation and no audit patch commits; CPU reference replays reproduce the results.
causal_limits: Normal-versus-audit results change task, prompt, input projection, output format, density and generation cap together. They do not isolate any one factor.
The captured acceptance has no identical-request adapter-disabled arm, so it cannot alone show that LoRA caused malformed audit JSON or harmed base competence.
No malformed JSON training target does not imply good coverage, good labels or adequate optimization. Those are separate evidence questions.
No direct evidence identifies a particular training example, rank, learning rate, training duration, quantization choice or internal attention pattern as the cause.
Post-hoc readable fragments are diagnostic observations only; no syntax-repaired report is executed or credited.
Strict validation is functioning as designed. Weakening it would risk executing the observed semantic errors and would not demonstrate lower intention omission.

minimal_next_diagnostic.comparison: Exact captured audit messages and pre-audit states; existing historical adapter-enabled outputs versus same frozen base/adapter loaded but disabled.
minimal_next_diagnostic.interpretation: An adapter-associated difference can be measured conditionally on these fixed audit requests; training-example causation and held-out benefits cannot be inferred.

review_limits: This is AI source inspection and deterministic artifact analysis, not independent human labeling.
The selected cases were already exposed and failures were known before this diagnosis.
